name: Microscope & Telescope Lab
desc: Build a compound microscope, refracting telescope or Newtonian reflector. Adjust focal lengths and optical path, trace rays and discover how focus and magnification work.
shortDesc: Three optical instruments, one ray bench: adjust lenses, mirrors and focus.
learningObjectives: Explain the roles of objective and eyepiece
Find the separation for relaxed-eye focus
Compare compound microscopes, refractors and Newtonian reflectors
Distinguish angular magnification from image position
modelAssumptions: Ideal thin lenses and mirrors; unfolded Newtonian optical path
Relaxed-eye focus; microscope reference distance 250 mm
Illustrative image preview; no diffraction, aberrations or aperture clipping
